title: Decision Provenance Standard self-declaration, format v1
description: A self-declaration an organization or a product makes about itself under the Decision Provenance Standard. An organization's declaration that includes declaration_page carries the four elements of Appendix G §G.11.4. It is the declarer's own claim; the Standard's Steward does not validate, grade or audit it. An organization declares a Conformance Level for its Charters (§7). A product never carries a Level.

name.description: The organization's or the product's name.

declaration_page.description: Optional. The public https:// page where the declaration can be read (usually the page carrying the badge). It may not contain spaces, quotes, angle brackets or backticks.

standard_version.description: The version the declaration is made against. New declarations use v1.3-rev11, the current text: v1.3 is a minor release, so a Charter that meets v1.2 also meets v1.3. v1.2-rev10, v1.1-rev9 and v1.0-rev8 are still accepted for declarations already made against them.

charters.description: Organizations only. The Charters covered, each as its name and ID, "Name (ID)", or in the organization's own words.

level.description: Organizations only. The Level every listed Charter reaches.

date.description: The date of the declaration, YYYY-MM-DD.

affirmed_by.description: The person at the declaring organization who stands behind the declaration.

enum: This is our own self-declaration, not a statement by the Standard's Steward. The Steward has not audited our records.
This is a self-declaration by the organization named here. The Standard's Steward does not certify it, including when the Steward is that organization.
statement.description: Copied word for word. Use the first statement, unless the organization declaring is the Standard's Steward: then use the second.

enum: This is our own statement about our product, not a statement by the Standard's Steward. The Steward has not reviewed or tested our product.
This is a self-declaration for the product named here. The Standard's Steward does not certify it, including when the Steward made the product.
statement.description: Copied word for word. Use the first statement, unless the Standard's Steward made the product: then use the second.
